items.claim_text:
Built Python ingestion and reconciliation jobs for 18 synthetic supplier datasets stored in PostgreSQL. Added checks for
missing identifiers, schema drift, impossible dates, and duplicate line items. Reduced median processing time from 34 to 22
minutes on a fixed weekly benchmark; this comparison did not measure company-wide productivity.
Implemented six FastAPI endpoints for an internal prototype, with Pydantic request models and documented error
responses. Wrote 44 API and data validation checks, including malformed dates, duplicate requests, and restart scenarios.
Participated in code review using Git and GitHub Actions.
Created Power BI reports showing freshness, volume changes, and reconciliation failures for five operations analysts.
Gathered requirements through weekly English-language discussions and documented definitions for recurring metrics. The
team used the reports for prototype evaluation, not regulated financial reporting.
Maintained a Docker development setup and reproducible local fixtures. Recorded latency distributions and failure causes,
then compared batching changes on the same input. Had no responsibility for Kubernetes administration, security
certification, employee hiring, or budget approval.

items.claim_text:
Used Tesseract, pypdf, and Pydantic to extract structured fields from 300 synthetic permit forms and public sample
documents. Added confidence thresholds, format validation, and a manual review queue. Exact-field accuracy was 92% on
an 80-document holdout, with handwritten inputs remaining difficult.
Recorded parsing latency and common error categories. The project never handled patient records, deployed in a hospital,
or claimed HIPAA compliance. Domain-specific production use would require additional expertise and controls.

items.claim_text:
Analyzed 120 days of anonymized vehicle-event fixtures with pandas and SQL, looking for missing updates and recurring
schedule gaps. Built a Tableau dashboard with route and time filters, and discussed findings with a four-person student

operations group.
Added reconciliation queries and documented assumptions about incomplete records. Estimated differences between
weekday and weekend patterns without claiming causal effects. Presented findings in English and revised visualizations after
stakeholder feedback.
